items.exampleEn: The plane waited at the end of the runway.
We missed our turning and got lost.
items.exampleZh: 我們錯過了該轉彎的路口，結果迷路了。

items.exampleEn: The first carriage of the train was empty.
items.exampleZh: 火車的第一節車廂是空的。

items.exampleEn: They wrote a book about their voyage.
items.exampleZh: 他們寫了一本關於這趟航行的書。

items.exampleEn: A submarine can stay under water for weeks.
items.exampleZh: 潛水艇可以在水下待好幾個星期。

items.exampleEn: Souvenir prices near the station are very high.
items.exampleZh: 車站附近的紀念品價格很高。

items.exampleEn: This train trip is famous for its scenic views.
items.exampleZh: 這趟火車之旅以沿途風景優美聞名。

items.sentenceEn: Snow closed the runway for two hours.
items.sentenceZh: 大雪讓跑道關閉了兩個小時。

items.audioEn: To get to the hotel, take the first turning after the bridge.
items.audioZh: 要去飯店的話，過橋後在第一個路口轉彎。

items.sentenceEn: The souvenir shop sells postcards and cups.
items.sentenceZh: 紀念品店賣明信片和杯子。

items.sentenceEn: The museum lets visitors walk inside an old submarine.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館讓參觀者走進一艘舊潛水艇裡。

items.stemEn: Our ____ to the island took four days by ship.
items.stemZh: 我們搭船到那座島的航程花了四天。

items.stemEn: We drove along the ____ coast road and stopped often to take photos.
items.stemZh: 我們沿著風景優美的海岸公路開車，常常停下來拍照。

items.passageEn: Tourism is very important for this small island. Visitors land at a tiny airport with one short runway. From there, a horse carriage takes them to the old harbor. The most popular trip is a short voyage in a yellow submarine to see colorful fish. On the way back, many people buy souvenirs, such as shells and postcards. The coast road is very scenic, and the turning near the bridge leads to a quiet beach.
items.passageZh: 觀光業對這座小島非常重要。遊客降落在一座只有一條短跑道的小機場。接著，一輛馬車載他們到老港口。最受歡迎的行程是搭黃色潛水艇短程航行，去看五顏六色的魚。回程時，很多人會買貝殼和明信片之類的紀念品。海岸公路風景優美，橋附近的路口通往一處安靜的海灘。

questions.questionZh: 最受歡迎的行程是什麼？
橋附近的路口通往哪裡？

items.promptZh: 觀光業是這座島最重要的產業。
referenceEn: Tourism is the most important industry on this island.
Tourism is this island's most important industry.
rubricZh: tourism 表示「觀光業」，是不可數名詞
「最重要的產業」可寫，例如 the most important industry、the main industry 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 她把旅行帶回來的紀念品放在書架上。
referenceEn: She keeps the souvenirs from her trips on a shelf.
She puts the souvenirs from her travels on the bookshelf.
rubricZh: 用 souvenir 表示「紀念品」（單複數都可以）
「放在書架上」可寫，例如 keeps … on a shelf、puts … on the bookshelf 等
